text: Antel (Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones) is a decentralised public service of the Uruguayan state, created by Decree-Law 14.235 of 1974.
short: Antel is Uruguay's state telecoms operator

source.name: IMPO (Uruguay's official law gazette): Decreto Ley N° 14.235 (Ley de creación de Antel), article 1
source.quote: Créase, con el nombre de Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ANTEL), un servicio público descentralizado.
source.note: English: 'A decentralised public service is created under the name Administración Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (ANTEL).' The page is served in Latin-1, so accents drop out when read as UTF-8; the quote matches the page's characters exactly.
